title: Glass Highway
style: dream pop, shoegaze, reverb-soaked guitars, female ethereal vocal, motorik drums, midtempo, melancholic, late-night driving, wide stereo
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Mile markers melt into the rain again
Headlights bleed across a film of glass
I thought I knew the road but the road has changed
Nothing on the dial, just the static pass

[Verse 2]
Ghost lanes opening where you used to ride
I keep your jacket folded on the empty side
The wipers count the heartbeats I forgot
The miles undo the knot

[Chorus]
This glass highway, this glass highway
Every exit is a memory I drive past
This glass highway, this glass highway
Nothing here is built to last

[Verse 3]
A gas station angel selling cigarettes
Asks me where I'm going, I say, not there yet
She smiles like she's heard it all before
And points me toward the door

[Chorus]
This glass highway, this glass highway
Every exit is a memory I drive past
This glass highway, this glass highway
Nothing here is built to last

[Bridge]
(guitars swell, drums steady)
Maybe forever was a soft headlight
Flickering once and gone into the night

[Outro]
Glass highway
Drive on
Drive on
